arxiv-2103-04030.creator: Junchao Shentu, Chen Zhao
arxiv-2103-04030.description: Abstract . Over an arbitrary compact complex space or an arbitrary germ of complex space X X , we provide fine resolutions of pure Hodge modules with strict supports I ​ C X ​ ( 𝕍 ) IC_{X}(\mathbb{V}) via differential forms with locally L 2 L^{2} boundary conditions.

arxiv-2103-13940.title: Reachability and Matching in Single Crossing Minor Free Graphs
arxiv-2103-13940.creator: Samir Datta, Chetan Gupta, Rahul Jain, Anish Mukherjee, Vimal Raj Sharma, Raghunath Tewari
arxiv-2103-13940.description: Abstract We show that for each single crossing graph H H , a polynomially bounded weight function for all H H -minor free graphs G G can be constructed in logspace such that it gives nonzero weights to all the cycles in G G .

arxiv-2110-07017.title: Unconditional uniqueness for the Benjamin-Ono equation
arxiv-2110-07017.creator: Razvan Mosincat, Didier Pilod
arxiv-2110-07017.description: Abstract . We study the unconditional uniqueness of solutions to the Benjamin-Ono equation with initial data in H s H^{s} , both on the real line and on the torus. We use the gauge transformation of Tao and two iterations of normal form reductions via integration by parts in time.

arxiv-2309-13702.title: Skill Check: Some Considerations on the Evaluation of Gamemastering Models for Role-playing Games
arxiv-2309-13702.creator: Santiago Góngora, Luis Chiruzzo, Gonzalo Méndez, Pablo Gervás
arxiv-2309-13702.description: Abstract In role-playing games a Game Master (GM) is the player in charge of the game, who must design the challenges the players face and narrate the outcomes of their actions. In this work we discuss some challenges to model GMs from an Interactive Storytelling and Natural Language Processing perspective.

arxiv-2504-05508.title: PartStickers: Generating Parts of Objects for Rapid Prototyping
arxiv-2504-05508.creator: Mo Zhou *, Josh Myers-Dean *, Danna Gurari
arxiv-2504-05508.description: Abstract Design prototyping involves creating mockups of products or concepts to gather feedback and iterate on ideas. While prototyping often requires specific parts of objects, such as when constructing a novel creature for a video game, existing text-to-image methods tend to only generate entire objects.

arxiv-2505-09044.title: Sensitivity of Trapping Efficiency and Relative Permeability to Experimental Methodology in Laboratory Core Flooding
arxiv-2505-09044.creator: Catherine Spurin, Catherine Callas, Takeshi Kurotori, Hamdi A. Tchelepi, Sally M. Benson
arxiv-2505-09044.description: Abstract Understanding the migration and trapping of CO 2 in the subsurface is vital to geologic carbon storage projects. Traditional characterization methods employ steady-state co-injection experiments to determine relative permeability and trapping efficiency. Although laboratory studies aim to replicate reservoir conditions, co-injection experiments are often selected because they facilitate steady-state flow and reduce capillary end effects.

arxiv-2509-17230.title: Exploring Bichronous Collaboration in Virtual Environments CCS: Human-centered computing Virtual reality CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in collaborative and social computing
arxiv-2509-17230.creator: Alexander Giovannelli, Shakiba Davari, Cherelle Connor, Fionn Murphy, Trey Davis, Haichao Miao, Vuthea Chheang, Brian Giera, Peer-Timo Bremer, Doug A. Bowman
arxiv-2509-17230.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexander Giovannelli, Shakiba Davari, Cherelle Connor, Fionn Murphy, Trey Davis, Haichao Miao, Vuthea Chheang, Brian Giera, Peer-Timo Bremer, Doug A. Bowman. Virtual environments (VEs) empower geographically distributed teams to collaborate on a shared project regardless of time. Existing research has separately investigated collaborations within these VEs at the same time (i.e., synchronous) or different times (i.e., asynchronous). In this work, we highlight the often-overlooked concept of bichronous collaboration and define it as the seamless integration of archived information during a real-time collaborative session.

arxiv-2510-26698.title: QED corrections to bound-muon decays from an effective-field-theory framework
arxiv-2510-26698.creator: Duarte Fontes, Robert Szafron
arxiv-2510-26698.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Duarte Fontes, Robert Szafron. Bound-muon decays are a powerful probe of new physics, making precise theoretical predictions for their spectra essential. While QED corrections significantly affect the shape of the spectra, their calculation is extremely challenging below the nuclear scale. By exploring the universality of modern effective-field-theory techniques, we present a framework that systematically computes those corrections across a broad class of bound-muon decays.

arxiv-2603-19466.title: ProactiveBench: Benchmarking Proactiveness in Multimodal Large Language Models

pmc-10583922.title: Surgical outcomes following breast reconstruction in patients with and without a history of chest radiotherapy for Hodgkin lymphoma: a multicentre, matched cohort study
pmc-10583922.creator: J Xavier Harmeling, Leonie AE Woerdeman, Ezgi Ozdemir, Michael Schaapveld, Hester SA Oldenburg, Cécile PM Janus, Nicola S Russell, Linetta B Koppert, Inge M Krul, Flora E van Leeuwen, Marc AM Mureau
pmc-10583922.description: Background:Breast cancer is the most common treatment-related second malignancy among women with previous chest radiotherapy for Hodgkin lymphoma (HL). Little is known about the effects of this kind of radiotherapy on the outcomes of postmastectomy breast reconstruction (BR). This study compared adverse outcomes of BR after HL-related chest radiotherapy to matched controls.

pmc-10682670.title: Cationic LNP-formulated mRNA expressing Tie2-agonist in the lung endothelium prevents pulmonary vascular leakage
pmc-10682670.creator: Katrin Radloff, Birgitt Gutbier, Charlotte Maeve Dunne, Hanieh Moradian, Marko Schwestka, Manfred Gossen, Katharina Ahrens, Laura Kneller, Yadong Wang, Akanksha Moga, Leonidas Gkionis, Oliver Keil, Volker Fehring, Daniel Tondera, Klaus Giese, Ansgar Santel, Jörg Kaufmann, Martin Witzenrath
pmc-10682670.description: Dysfunction of endothelial cells (ECs) lining the inner surface of blood vessels are causative for a number of diseases. Hence, the ability to therapeutically modulate gene expression within ECs is of high therapeutic value in treating diseases such as those associated with lung edema.

pmc-11347785.title: The significance of CD16+ monocytes in the occurrence and development of chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension: insights from single-cell RNA sequencing
pmc-11347785.creator: Maohe Chen, Qiuxia Wu, Nan Shao, Xingyue Lai, Huo Lin, Min Chen, Yijing Wu, Jiafan Chen, Qinghuang Lin, Jiahui Huang, Xiaoyun Chen, Wei Yan, Shi Chen, Hongli Li, Dawen Wu, Minxia Yang, Chaosheng Deng
pmc-11347785.description: BackgroundChronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH) is a serious pulmonary vascular disease characterized by residual thrombi in the pulmonary arteries and distal pulmonary microvascular remodeling. The pathogenesis of CTEPH remains unclear, but many factors such as inflammation, immunity, coagulation and angiogenesis may be involved.

pmc-11596059.title: The Impact of Heart Failure Chronic Treatment Prior to Cardiac Transplantation on Early Outcomes
pmc-11596059.creator: Dragos-Florin Baba, Horatiu Suciu, Calin Avram, Marius Mihai Harpa, Mircea Stoian, Diana-Andreea Moldovan, Laurentiu Huma, Gabriel Rusu, Tunde Pal, Alina Danilesco, Adina Stoian, Anca-Ileana Sin, Ignatios Ikonomidis, Simona Dragan, Nilima Rajpal Kundnani
pmc-11596059.description: Background and Objectives: Cardiac transplantation represents the option for patients with end-stage heart failure (HF), providing the best survival rate. However, the postoperative complications of transplant patients remain a challenge for clinicians. The objective of our study was to evaluate the effect of preoperative chronic HF treatment on the occurrence of in-hospital complications.

pmc-11680000.title: Research on Flower Pattern and Roll Positioning Optimization for Roll Forming Process of TA4 Coiled Tubing
pmc-11680000.creator: Xuwen Deng, Songxiao Hui, Xiongyue Ye, Wenjun Ye, Yang Yu, Yunbo Li, Franz E Weber
pmc-11680000.description: Titanium alloy coiled tubing (CT) has great superiority while operating in deep wells with severe conditions, but it faces serious challenges during roll forming like high springback, edge cracking and surface wearing. In order to utilize the high precision and high efficiency production of titanium alloy CT, it is urgently necessary to develop a detailed process design.

pmc-12358539.title: A study of the radon seasonality with temporal dummy variables
pmc-12358539.creator: Alessandro Pignatelli, Giulia Romoli, Veronica Vignoli
pmc-12358539.description: Radon, a naturally occurring radioactive gas, has garnered significant attention due to its health risks and its potential role as a seismic indicator. Variations in radon levels have been observed in correlation with seismic activity, suggesting that radon could serve as an early warning signal for earthquakes.

pmc-12438864.title: Personality traits and risk of eating disorders among Polish women: the moderating role of self-esteem
pmc-12438864.creator: K. Rachubińska, D. Schneider-Matyka, A. M. Cybulska, M. Nowak, E. Grochans
pmc-12438864.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionPersonality dimensions should be taken into account when diagnosing individuals with disordered eating behaviours in the hope of better understanding their etiology and symptom progression and when planning treatment.ObjectivesThe objective of this study was to attempt to determine the moderating role of self-esteem in the relationships between personality traits included in the Big Five model among Polish women and the occurrence of eating disorders.MethodsThe study was conducted among 556 Polish women from Zachodniopomorskie Voivodeship.

pmc-12581131.title: Solvent-Driven Modulation of Shuttling Dynamics in an Autonomous Chemically Fueled Information Ratchet
pmc-12581131.creator: Giuseppe Silvestri, Mattia P. Fossati, Federica Arrigoni, Luca Bertini, Giuseppe Zampella, Luca De Gioia, Jacopo Vertemara
pmc-12581131.description: The performance of artificial molecular machines relies on the interplay between molecular design and environmental factors, yet how solvation shapes their energy landscapes and kinetics remains poorly understood. Here, we combine well-tempered and infrequent metadynamics to investigate equilibrium shuttling in a minimal [2]­rotaxane inspired by Borsley’s fuel-driven molecular motor.

pmc-13327921.creator: Lei Zhang, Ying Luo, Shubo Liu, Huiting Deng, Yingtang Gao

pmc-13559827.title: OTUD5 maintains STAT1/2 stability and promotes IFNγ-driven intestinal inflammation
pmc-13559827.creator: Huiyuan Guan, Changzhou Cai, Jiewei Wang, Zhaoxue Liu, Jin Peng, Xupeng Bai, Lingzhi Wu, Kun Jiang, Xinghua Zhen, Chaohui Yu, Pumin Zhang, Zhe Shen
pmc-13559827.description: Inflammatory bowel disease is characterized by unresolved mucosal inflammation driven mainly by TNFα and/or interferon gamma (IFNγ). While anti-TNFα biologics are a clinical mainstay, therapeutic resistance remains a significant hurdle. The molecular mechanisms that sustain inflammation in anti-TNFα nonresponders are not fully understood.

pmc-13645962.title: Analyzing the Ratio Between Prenatal Consultations and Live Births in Brazil: Spatial and Professional Patterns, 2008–2023
pmc-13645962.creator: Márcio Cristiano de Melo, Jucilene Casati Lodi, Luiz Eduardo Coelho Emerenciano, Nayara Amelia Guirau Veronez, Tassia Fraga Bastos, Naila Albertina de Oliveira
pmc-13645962.description: This study analyzed the ratio between antenatal care visits and live births (LB) in Brazil as an indicator of service utilization intensity. This nationwide ecological longitudinal study combined descriptive temporal and spatial analyses of outpatient antenatal consultations recorded in SIA/SUS and LB reported in SINASC across Brazilian federative units and macroregions from 2008 to 2023.
